aggregates.text: THE MANDATORY AI RULE IS TWENTY MONTHS OLD
aggregates.note: The standard's own effective date line to the day the regents reviewed the draft that would follow it. Completed calendar months, and the cover's whole assertion.

aggregates.text: Three classes. Three different answers about where a tool may take them.
aggregates.subject: classes
aggregates.note: The three data classifications the standard itself defines: Public, Internal Use, Restricted.

aggregates.text: Three classes. Three different answers about where a tool may take them.
aggregates.subject: different answers
aggregates.note: The same three classifications counted again in the second sentence. One answer per class, so the two counts are the same three claims and can never disagree.

A property of the ARTWORK. The gate is drawn with three graduated chutes because the deck's gate carries its whole gold budget and the opening is the point; no source says the standard has three of anything at the gate. The three CLASSIFICATIONS are a separate assertion and are declared on slide 4 against C12, C13 and C14.
Not derived. Quoted from KTOO's account of the draft policy, which says it would require all three campuses to develop AI implementation plans.
